verdict.rationale: Close's pricing page lists "Automated workflows" and "Use Chloe in Workflows" as product features, and the developer docs mention managing workflows via sequences. That establishes a first-party workflow automation capability, but nothing describes its triggers or actions. Webhooks, the REST API and bulk actions are developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documentation of trigger conditions, workflow actions that update records, automatic task creation, automatic notification actions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
